perturbation: independent uniform court-plane discs for each proxy position
selection: eight availability-selected 0.8-second windows; three matched set-phase cells
limitations: The radius is the maximum of 11 selected, approximate single-reviewer clear-shoe marks at one non-anchor frame per window. Five selected slots were unmarkable, manual reading uncertainty is about ±12 source pixels per axis, and this 16-slot subset contains no full six-player frame. A separate selected full-team frame check does not make this an empirical error distribution. The disc perturbations are a scenario, not an empirical error distribution, upper bound, confidence interval, or confirmatory outcome test.
